authoritativeContracts.needle:
The TypeScript SDK can load and merge an Automerge document (`AutomergeSync`,
  `elohim/sdk/storage-client-ts/src/sync.ts`).

Browser persistence and offline resumption belong
in shared client support; UI frameworks bind it rather than implementing independent
queues, publication state machines or admission rules.
